note: NEWTECONS Vietnamese word timing v001 (user approved 2026-10-31: phu de/karaoke vao engine). Values are Sol's draft (docs/specs/2026-10-31-newtecons-audio-timing-recipes-v001.md section 7) except two measured deviations by lane KARAOKE-REVIEW-NTC on the S02_A pilot WAV (sha eddc741b...): (1) model_label 'small' = Systran/faster-whisper-small, the only Vietnamese-capable model installed (machine.timing.model_dir); Sol proposed large-v3, which is NOT installed, and the engine never downloads; (2) accept_similarity 0.45 (the cartoon's proven value) because faster-whisper-small hears 'gap' as 'thap' (similarity 0.571) and Sol's 0.8 would refuse a correctly spoken line. Vietnamese words are whitespace tokens with diacritics kept (NFC). Not NEWTECONS-qualified by a listening pilot yet; thresholds remain proposed calibration inputs at 24 fps (early > 1 f FAIL, late <= 2 f PASS, 3-4 f WARN, > 4 f FAIL).
